source.finding: Contains generic Civilization IV diplomatic responses, not leader-specific first-contact entries for these 19 EMM/FfH leaders.
source.otherFileFinding: Empty in the pinned repository snapshot. No original bespoke EMM/FfH dialogue sourced for the selected 19 leaders.

adaptation: Original lore-inspired dialogue written for this Unciv mod, NOT verbatim dialogue from Fall from Heaven II or ExtraModMod Continued. Do not present these as authentic quotations.

Amurites.introduction: I am Valledia the Even. The Amurites preserve the arts of magic, and we would learn what wisdom your people possess.
Amurites.neutralHello: Knowledge is worth sharing with those who respect it.
Amurites.hateHello: You mistake patience for ignorance. Make your point.
Amurites.declaringWar: You have shown that words will not keep dangerous power in check. The Amurites march.
Amurites.attacked: So. You would test your steel against our sorcery?
Amurites.defeated: Our libraries fall silent. May their knowledge survive us.
Amurites.tradeRequest: An exchange of knowledge and goods would benefit us both.

Balseraphs.introduction: Welcome, welcome! Perpentach welcomes you to his grand performance. Do try not to leave before the final act.
Balseraphs.hateHello: Have you come to entertain me? You are doing a very poor job.
Balseraphs.declaringWar: The curtains rise! Our little war will be the finest show in Erebus.
Balseraphs.attacked: You mean to kill the performers? How terribly unsporting!
Balseraphs.defeated: The audience has gone home... but I can still hear their applause.
Balseraphs.tradeRequest: A bargain! Every wonderful show needs a surprise.

Bannor.introduction: I am Sabathiel of the Bannor. We stand for order and the righteous defense of our people.
Bannor.neutralHello: The Bannor honor those who keep their oaths.
Bannor.hateHello: State your business plainly. We have little patience for deceit.
Bannor.declaringWar: You leave us no honorable path but war. May our cause be just.
Bannor.attacked: Then the Bannor shall answer your aggression with steadfast resolve.
Bannor.defeated: Our walls have fallen, but our duty was never in vain.
Bannor.tradeRequest: Let us agree to terms both our peoples can uphold.

Calabim.introduction: I am Alexis, mistress of the Calabim. You may find our hospitality quite unforgettable.
Calabim.neutralHello: Come closer. There is much we might discuss.
Calabim.hateHello: Do not confuse my courtesy with an invitation to defy me.
Calabim.declaringWar: Your lands will nourish the Calabim. Be grateful for the honor.
Calabim.attacked: You bare your throat to a predator and call it courage?
Calabim.defeated: Even the oldest hunger must someday be stilled.
Calabim.tradeRequest: Every gift has a price. Shall we discuss yours?

Clan of Embers.introduction: Jonas Endain speaks for the Clan of Embers. Our fires burn bright, and we will not be driven away.
Clan of Embers.neutralHello: Keep your warriors strong and your fires fed.
Clan of Embers.hateHello: You talk too much for one who brings so little.
Clan of Embers.declaringWar: The Clan gathers. Soon you will hear our war drums.
Clan of Embers.attacked: You have called down the wrath of the Clan upon yourself.
Clan of Embers.defeated: The last embers fade. Remember that we were never tame.
Clan of Embers.tradeRequest: What will you offer the Clan in return?

Doviello.introduction: I am Charadon. The Doviello survive by strength, not by hiding behind walls.
Doviello.neutralHello: If you have something worth saying, say it.
Doviello.hateHello: Weak words. Weak people. I have no need of either.
Doviello.declaringWar: My warriors hunger for battle. Your lands will serve.
Doviello.attacked: Good. Now we learn which of us is stronger.
Doviello.defeated: The pack is broken. Others will take its place.
Doviello.tradeRequest: A fair trade is one where both sides leave stronger.

Elohim.introduction: I am Ethne the White. The Elohim guard places that must not be forgotten. May we meet in peace.
Elohim.neutralHello: May your travels be peaceful and your burdens light.
Elohim.hateHello: You stand before one who has seen too much ruin. Do not bring more.
Elohim.declaringWar: We sought peace, but will defend those entrusted to our care.
Elohim.attacked: There is no glory in this bloodshed. We will endure it nonetheless.
Elohim.defeated: Our sanctuaries are lost. I pray their memory survives.
Elohim.tradeRequest: Let us make an agreement that spares both our peoples suffering.

Grigori.introduction: I am Cassiel of the Grigori. Our fate belongs to mortals, not to gods who demand our obedience.
Grigori.neutralHello: You are welcome to speak freely here.
Grigori.hateHello: Keep your prophecies and threats. We answer to neither.
Grigori.declaringWar: No divine command sends us to war. We have judged this necessary ourselves.
Grigori.attacked: You will find the Grigori choose their own battles.
Grigori.defeated: At least our choices were our own.
Grigori.tradeRequest: Let us deal as equals, without oaths to unseen masters.

Hippus.introduction: Tasunke leads the Hippus. Our riders have crossed a thousand leagues; perhaps our roads will meet in friendship.
Hippus.neutralHello: A good horse and an open road are fine company.
Hippus.hateHello: Stop wasting daylight. My riders have places to be.
Hippus.declaringWar: The Hippus ride to war. You will hear us before you see us.
Hippus.attacked: Then saddle your best warriors. We are ready.
Hippus.defeated: The last of our riders has fallen. The road goes on without us.
Hippus.tradeRequest: Name your price. The Hippus know the worth of a good bargain.

Illians.introduction: I am Auric Ulvin. The Illians endure where other peoples perish beneath the winter sky.
Illians.hateHello: You speak as though the winter could be bargained away.
Illians.declaringWar: The age of ice draws nearer. You will not stand against it.
Illians.attacked: Your armies will learn what it means to face the endless cold.
Illians.defeated: Even winter yields, at last, to time.
Illians.tradeRequest: I will consider an exchange, if it serves our purpose.

Khazad.introduction: Arturus Thorne greets you on behalf of the Khazad. Our halls run deep, and our word is as solid as stone.
Khazad.neutralHello: May your vaults be full and your foundations sound.
Khazad.hateHello: We have no patience for a bargain built on empty promises.
Khazad.declaringWar: You have struck at the roots of our kingdom. The Khazad answer with steel.
Khazad.attacked: Stone endures. Your assault will not break our resolve.
Khazad.defeated: Our halls are silent, but their foundations will outlast us.
Khazad.tradeRequest: Show me a fair price and we may have an agreement.

Kuriotates.introduction: I am Cardith Lorda of the Kuriotates. We seek a realm in which many peoples may prosper together.
Kuriotates.neutralHello: There is room in Erebus for a better future.
Kuriotates.hateHello: You would squander the peace we have worked to build?
Kuriotates.declaringWar: We will defend the promise of our realm against your aggression.
Kuriotates.attacked: The Kuriotates will not surrender their future to fear.
Kuriotates.defeated: Our dream passes into memory. Let others dream it anew.
Kuriotates.tradeRequest: Let us build prosperity through an honest exchange.

Lanun.introduction: Falamar, at your service. I speak for the Lanun, whose sails know more horizons than most kings.
Lanun.neutralHello: Fair winds to you, friend. What news from beyond the horizon?
Lanun.hateHello: Careful now. The sea has swallowed louder fools than you.
Lanun.declaringWar: Raise the sails and ready the guns. We have a quarrel to settle.
Lanun.attacked: You would hunt the Lanun on our own waters? Try your luck.
Lanun.defeated: The tide has turned against us. No captain sails forever.
Lanun.tradeRequest: Every cargo has a price. What do you bring to the table?

Ljosalfar.introduction: I am Arendel Phaedra of the Ljosalfar. May our meeting bring no harm to the living forests.
Ljosalfar.neutralHello: The woods are peaceful today. Let us keep them so.
Ljosalfar.hateHello: Do not mistake the quiet of the forest for weakness.
Ljosalfar.declaringWar: You threaten what we have sworn to protect. Our bows are drawn.
Ljosalfar.attacked: The forests have endured ages of fire. They will endure you.
Ljosalfar.defeated: Our songs fade among the trees. Remember them kindly.
Ljosalfar.tradeRequest: If our peoples can trade without harming the land, we shall listen.

Luchuirp.introduction: I am Garrim Gyr of the Luchuirp. With skilled hands and patient minds, even stone can be made to serve.
Luchuirp.neutralHello: A clever invention is always worth a conversation.
Luchuirp.hateHello: If you have nothing useful to add, step away from the workbench.
Luchuirp.declaringWar: You have broken what we built. Now you will see what else we can make.
Luchuirp.attacked: Our creations are ready to defend their makers.
Luchuirp.defeated: Our workshops grow still. Perhaps someone will finish what we began.
Luchuirp.tradeRequest: Bring honest materials and we may craft an honest bargain.

Malakim.introduction: I am Varn Gosam of the Malakim. From the desert we have learned faith, endurance, and the value of clear sight.
Malakim.neutralHello: May the sun light the path before you.
Malakim.hateHello: The desert strips away false appearances. Your words will not conceal your intent.
Malakim.declaringWar: We march beneath the desert sun. Your injustice ends here.
Malakim.attacked: You have mistaken our restraint for frailty.
Malakim.defeated: The sands reclaim our cities. May wisdom outlive them.
Malakim.tradeRequest: May this exchange be fair beneath the same sun that shines on us both.

Sheaim.introduction: I am Tebryn Arbandi of the Sheaim. Some doors are better opened than left to rot upon their hinges.
Sheaim.neutralHello: So many mysteries remain. Which shall we uncover today?
Sheaim.hateHello: Your fear of forbidden knowledge grows tiresome.
Sheaim.declaringWar: The world you cherish is already passing. We shall hasten its end.
Sheaim.attacked: You strike at the Sheaim? Then you have yet to grasp what awaits.
Sheaim.defeated: Even our designs can unravel. The end will find another path.
Sheaim.tradeRequest: Power takes many forms. What might you offer in exchange?

Sidar.introduction: I am Sandalphon of the Sidar. We have watched kingdoms rise and fade, and learned the strength of silence.
Sidar.neutralHello: Time reveals what hurried words conceal.
Sidar.hateHello: Your noise disturbs those who would rather remain unseen.
Sidar.declaringWar: You have left us no choice but to step from the shadows.
Sidar.attacked: The Sidar do not forget those who threaten them.
Sidar.defeated: Our shadows dissolve, as all things must.
Sidar.tradeRequest: We may exchange what you need for what we value.

Svartalfar.introduction: I am Faeryl Viconia of the Svartalfar. We know the forests by moonlight, and we prefer our secrets kept.
Svartalfar.neutralHello: A whispered word often carries farther than a shout.
Svartalfar.hateHello: Speak carefully. In our forests, careless visitors disappear.
Svartalfar.declaringWar: The night belongs to us. You will learn what that means.
Svartalfar.attacked: You have entered the dark without knowing what watches you.
Svartalfar.defeated: The shadows close over our kingdom. Another will claim the night.
Svartalfar.tradeRequest: Perhaps we can arrange a discreet and profitable exchange.
